vulnerabilities.description: Confirmed Regex Injection. User input from DSBL_REJ option (stored in DB) is passed directly to preg_match(). Although protection against /e flag exists (lines 57-67), an attacker can still cause ReDoS or use other dangerous regex constructs.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Replace preg_match() with safer string comparison methods. Use strpos() or fnmatch() for simple path matching.

data.summary: Found 3 vulnerabilities in 3 files out of 61 scanned. Max severity: medium.
